failed_or_requires_guard.requirement: local mode only; no cloud routing
failed_or_requires_guard.observed: An unknown project name produced: 'Cloud routing requested but no credentials found. Run bm cloud api-key save <key> or bm cloud login first.' It failed closed only because no credentials exist on this host. The fallback path for an unresolvable project is cloud, not refusal.

failed_or_requires_guard.requirement: bilingual retrieval works with a supported local multilingual model
failed_or_requires_guard.observed: semantic_min_similarity defaults to 0.55, calibrated for the default English bge-small-en-v1.5. With the required multilingual model, correct answers score 0.311-0.558, so only 1 of 9 questions returned anything at the default. At a threshold derived from the measured nonsense-query noise ceiling (0.238) plus margin -> 0.30, all 9 returned the intended note at rank 1. Basic Memory provides no per-model calibration or documented recommended threshold.
failed_or_requires_guard.important_qualifier: This is fail-closed (empty results), never a confident wrong answer.

failed_or_requires_guard.observed: bm status --wait polls get_project_status roughly every 0.6s. Each poll restarts a 'First sync for this project, performing full scan' that finds the same 7 new files and never applies them. It never converges when no indexer process is running; 124s of CPU burned before it was stopped, and it would have run to its full timeout. bm reindex is the working sync path.

On first sync the provider rewrote all 14 notes, adding a 'permalink:' key to frontmatter and unquoting the 'title' value (ensure_frontmatter_on_sync defaults true). 0 of 14 files are byte-identical to the frozen corpus.
failed_or_requires_guard.important_qualifier: The result is human-readable, Git-compatible and non-destructive to note bodies. It is a mutation of owner content, not corruption. Phase C's byte-identical result was measured relative to this already-mutated state, so it proves rebuild stability - repeated rebuilds change nothing further - but NOT that the provider never writes to canonical files.

failed_or_requires_guard.requirement: isolated installation without a global compiler
failed_or_requires_guard.observed: Default resolution selects litellm 1.93.0, which publishes only manylinux wheels. On Windows pip must build its sdist, which requires a Rust toolchain and fails. Pinned to litellm 1.91.4, the newest stable version inside basic-memory's own declared range >=1.60.0,<2.0.0 that ships a pure-Python wheel.
failed_or_requires_guard.important_qualifier: No Rust toolchain was installed by this pilot; the pre-existing .cargo and .rustup directories were not touched.
